receVScD8jAR9ERke.Name: hfbasinpmadv
receVScD8jAR9ERke.Title: Northward Ocean Heat Transport Due to Parameterized Mesoscale Advection

receWRkSC1NmREnEb.Description: carbon concentration from the diazotrophic phytoplankton component alone
receWRkSC1NmREnEb.Name: phydiazos
receWRkSC1NmREnEb.Title: Surface Mole Concentration of Diazotrophs Expressed as Carbon in Sea Water

recerahB6xzUgj4EP.Description: Flux of Nitrogen from the land into the atmosphere due to all processes other than fire
recerahB6xzUgj4EP.Name: fNgasNonFire
recerahB6xzUgj4EP.Title: Total Nitrogen Lost to the Atmosphere (Including NHx, NOx, N2O, N2) from All Processes Except Fire

recesVwYPF4NbkfdZ.Description: Omega (vertical velocity in pressure coordinates, positive downwards)
recesVwYPF4NbkfdZ.Name: wap
recesVwYPF4NbkfdZ.Title: Omega (=dp/dt)

recewW6WT48xzVwA2.Description: Actual thickness of snow in each ice thickness category, NOT snow volume divided by grid area (vector with one entry for each ice thickness category starting from the thinnest category, netcdf file should use thickness bounds of categories as third coordinate axis). It can also be derived by dividing the volume of snow by the area of snow in each thickness category.
recewW6WT48xzVwA2.Name: siitdsnthick
recewW6WT48xzVwA2.Title: Snow Thickness in Ice Thickness Categories

recf5tazKoqWyoZ8c.Description: Mole fraction is used in the construction mole\_fraction\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.
recf5tazKoqWyoZ8c.Name: so2
recf5tazKoqWyoZ8c.Title: SO2 Volume Mixing Ratio

recf6iiyiTuK1XEzY.Description: Mole fraction is used in the construction mole\_fraction\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.   The chemical formula of  nitrous oxide is N2O.
recf6iiyiTuK1XEzY.Name: n2o
recf6iiyiTuK1XEzY.Title: Mole Fraction of N2O

recf7C93Fj3vSvsGR.Description: Mole fraction is used in the construction mole\_fraction\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.
recf7C93Fj3vSvsGR.Name: pan
recf7C93Fj3vSvsGR.Title: PAN Volume Mixing Ratio

recfAFhl0FDSXIKq0.Name: fHarvestToGeologicStorage
recfAFhl0FDSXIKq0.Title: Harvested Biomass That Goes into Geological Storage

recfFZBMTXk8yHaMb.Description: Tendency of specific humidity due to numerical diffusion.This includes any horizontal or vertical numerical moisture diffusion not associated with the parametrized moist physics or the resolved dynamics.  For example, any vertical diffusion which is part of the boundary layer mixing scheme should be excluded, as should any diffusion which is included in the terms from the resolved dynamics.   This term is required to check the closure of the moisture budget.
recfFZBMTXk8yHaMb.Name: tnhusd
recfFZBMTXk8yHaMb.Title: Tendency of Specific Humidity Due to Numerical Diffusion

recfGWfEFN6WFMTGd.Description: Report missing data over ocean grid cells. For fractional land report value averaged over the land fraction.
recfGWfEFN6WFMTGd.Name: nVeg
recfGWfEFN6WFMTGd.Title: Nitrogen Mass in Vegetation

recfHnYDqea5plwOb.Description: Tendency of heat content for a grid cell from parameterized mesoscale eddy diffusion. Reported only for models that use potential temperature as prognostic field.
recfHnYDqea5plwOb.Name: opottemppmdiff
recfHnYDqea5plwOb.Title: Tendency of Sea Water Potential Temperature Expressed as Heat Content Due to Parameterized Mesoscale Diffusion

recfSnztE5RYH5h4f.Description: From all sources,  Including natural, anthropogenic and Land-use change. Only total fire emissions can be compared to observations.
recfSnztE5RYH5h4f.Name: fFireAll
recfSnztE5RYH5h4f.Title: Carbon Mass Flux into Atmosphere Due to CO2 Emission from Fire Including All Sources [kgC m-2 s-1]

recfWHFn5TqLiNLEw.Description: The total run-off (including drainage through the base of the soil model) per unit area leaving the land portion of the grid cell.
recfWHFn5TqLiNLEw.Name: mrroIs
recfWHFn5TqLiNLEw.Title: Ice Sheet Total Runoff

recfcIschpd68x36r.Description: "Calcareous phytoplankton" are phytoplankton that produce calcite. Calcite is a mineral that is a polymorph of calcium carbonate. The chemical formula of calcite is CaCO3. Phytoplankton are algae that grow where there is sufficient light to support photosynthesis. "Nitrogen growth limitation" means the ratio of the growth rate of a species population in the environment (where there is a finite availability of nitrogen) to the theoretical growth rate if there were no such limit on nitrogen availability.
recfcIschpd68x36r.Name: limncalc
recfcIschpd68x36r.Title: Nitrogen Limitation of Calcareous Phytoplankton

recffakZsL64FYbCf.Description: Integrate 3D emission field vertically to 2d field.
recffakZsL64FYbCf.Name: eminh3
recffakZsL64FYbCf.Title: Total Emission Rate of NH3

recflVP5rMqbwrrlb.Description: Direct primary emission does not include secondary sulfate production. Integrate 3D emission field vertically to 2d field.
recflVP5rMqbwrrlb.Name: emiso4
recflVP5rMqbwrrlb.Title: Total Direct Emission Rate of SO4

recfrBU0JTzYrCrxa.Name: nOther
recfrBU0JTzYrCrxa.Title: Nitrogen Mass in Vegetation Components Other than Leaves, Stem and Root

recfrih3zuqhOhfxf.Description: In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics. "Litter" is dead plant material in or above the soil. "Vegetation" means any living plants e.g. trees, shrubs, grass.
recfrih3zuqhOhfxf.Name: fNVegLitter
recfrih3zuqhOhfxf.Title: Total Nitrogen Mass Flux from Vegetation to Litter

recfscAlNCngUQqKW.Description: The total dry mass of sulfate aerosol particles per unit area.
recfscAlNCngUQqKW.Name: loadso4
recfscAlNCngUQqKW.Title: Load of SO4

recfshEOhX3Tb1OYa.Description: Wave period associated with the most energetic wind-sea waves (i.e., local wind waves). In spectral wind wave models, this represents the spectral peak across part of the two-dimensional wave spectrum, incorporating just wind-sea waves.
recfshEOhX3Tb1OYa.Name: wppwindsea
recfshEOhX3Tb1OYa.Title: Wind Sea Wave Peak Period

recfskdXWBNxOxnLi.Description: A velocity is a vector quantity. "y" indicates a vector component along the grid y-axis, positive with increasing y. "Land ice" means glaciers, ice-caps and ice-sheets resting on bedrock and also includes ice-shelves. The surface called "surface" means the lower boundary of the atmosphere.'
recfskdXWBNxOxnLi.Name: yvelsurf
recfskdXWBNxOxnLi.Title: Y-Component of Land Ice Surface Velocity

recfx8WZfi5HDIFac.Description: Where convective cloud is present in the grid cell, the instantaneous cloud base altitude should be that of the bottom of the lowest level containing convective cloud. Missing data should be reported in the absence of convective cloud. The time mean should be calculated from these quantities averaging over occasions when convective cloud is present only, and should contain missing data for occasions when no convective cloud is present during the meaning period.
recfx8WZfi5HDIFac.Name: ccb
recfx8WZfi5HDIFac.Title: Air Pressure at Convective Cloud Base

recfyDzLwSEWR989P.Description: sum of phytoplankton carbon component concentrations.  In most (all?) cases this is the sum of phycdiat and phycmisc (i.e., "Diatom Carbon Concentration" and "Non-Diatom Phytoplankton Carbon Concentration"
recfyDzLwSEWR989P.Name: phyc
recfyDzLwSEWR989P.Title: Phytoplankton Carbon Concentration

recfz338u0V3dtVmp.Description: Integral over the full ocean depth of the product of sea water density and potential temperature.
recfz338u0V3dtVmp.Name: opottempmint
recfz338u0V3dtVmp.Title: Integral with Respect to Depth of Product of Sea Water Density and Potential Temperature

recg1h9hAy22YlX8h.Description: 2D monthly mean thermal tropopause calculated using WMO tropopause definition on 3d temperature
recg1h9hAy22YlX8h.Name: tatp
recg1h9hAy22YlX8h.Title: Tropopause Air Temperature

recgFbPvH0W73zYDU.Description: Tracer grid-cell mass per unit area used for computing tracer budgets. For Boussinesq models with static ocean grid cell thickness, masscello = rhozero\*thickcello, where thickcello is static cell thickness and rhozero is constant Boussinesq reference density. More generally, masscello is time dependent and reported as part of Omon.
recgFbPvH0W73zYDU.Name: masscello
recgFbPvH0W73zYDU.Processing Comment: If constant, report as a fixed configuration field, otherwise report as time varying.
recgFbPvH0W73zYDU.Title: Ocean Grid-Cell Mass per Area

recgGMIGvWpUFoRpc.Description: Actual thickness of snow averaged over the snow-covered part of the sea ice. This thickness is usually directly available within the model formulation. It can also be derived by dividing the total volume of snow by the area of the snow.
recgGMIGvWpUFoRpc.Name: sisnthick
recgGMIGvWpUFoRpc.Title: Snow Thickness

recgGiuYyQGPKE9CF.Description: Mass fraction in the atmosphere of sea salt aerosol (dry mass).
recgGiuYyQGPKE9CF.Name: mmrss
recgGiuYyQGPKE9CF.Title: Sea-Salt Aerosol Mass Mixing Ratio

recgNY5DoEYCWX9li.Description: Ocean bathymetry.   Reported here is the sea floor depth for present day relative to z=0 geoid. Reported as missing for land grid cells.
recgNY5DoEYCWX9li.Name: deptho
recgNY5DoEYCWX9li.Title: Sea Floor Depth Below Geoid

recgeGSXv10z5TomC.Description: Percentage of grid cell covered by floating ice shelf, the component of the ice sheet that is flowing over sea water
recgeGSXv10z5TomC.Name: sftflf
recgeGSXv10z5TomC.Title: Floating Ice Shelf Area Percentage

recghFUoJ7KAln3Zf.Description: zero for models using real water fluxes.
recghFUoJ7KAln3Zf.Name: vsfevap
recghFUoJ7KAln3Zf.Title: Virtual Salt Flux into Sea Water Due to Evaporation

recgkdmOTDfGGmf8d.Description: This is the percentage of the entire grid cell that is covered by needleleaf evergreen trees.
recgkdmOTDfGGmf8d.Name: treeFracNdlEvg
recgkdmOTDfGGmf8d.Title: Needleleaf Evergreen Tree Area Percentage

recgmEdPjzVPkUPaZ.Description: If model lumps secondary organic aerosol (SOA) emissions with primary organic aerosol (POA), then the sum of POA and SOA emissions is reported as OA emissions. Here, mass refers to the mass of primary organic matter, not mass of organic carbon alone.
recgmEdPjzVPkUPaZ.Name: chepsoa
recgmEdPjzVPkUPaZ.Title: Chemical Production of Dry Aerosol Secondary Organic Matter

recgmuBRTDr6mxM4J.Description: Air temperature is the bulk temperature of the air, not the surface (skin) temperature.
recgmuBRTDr6mxM4J.Name: tasLut
recgmuBRTDr6mxM4J.Title: Near-Surface Air Temperature on Land Use Tile

recgpE9l72JzxiPEl.Description: This is the stress on the liquid ocean from overlying atmosphere, sea ice, ice shelf, etc.
recgpE9l72JzxiPEl.Name: tauuo
recgpE9l72JzxiPEl.Title: Sea Water Surface Downward X Stress

recgpUbsOJ2Br0DpK.Description: zero for models using real water fluxes.
recgpUbsOJ2Br0DpK.Name: vsfriver
recgpUbsOJ2Br0DpK.Title: Virtual Salt Flux into Sea Water from Rivers

recgqGslcW1IIdTA9.Description: carbon concentration from calcareous (calcite-producing) phytoplankton component alone
recgqGslcW1IIdTA9.Name: phycalc
recgqGslcW1IIdTA9.Title: Mole Concentration of Calcareous Phytoplankton Expressed as Carbon in Sea Water

recgr7gZJi5phetwz.Description: Vertically integrated eastward dry static energy transport (cp.T +zg).v (Mass\_weighted\_vertical integral of the product of eastward wind by dry static\_energy per mass unit)
recgr7gZJi5phetwz.Name: intuadse
recgr7gZJi5phetwz.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Title - CMIP6:Vertically Integrated Eastward Dry Statice Energy Transport CMIP7:Vertically Integrated Eastward Dry Static Energy Transport
recgr7gZJi5phetwz.Title: Vertically Integrated Eastward Dry Static Energy Transport

recgsLBqhQE38OTqR.Description: Sum of particulate aragonite components (e.g. Phytoplankton, Detrital, etc.)
recgsLBqhQE38OTqR.Name: arag
recgsLBqhQE38OTqR.Title: Aragonite Concentration

recgt8Y5EIUcGUzfD.Description: Percentage of entire grid cell covered by C4 pasture
recgt8Y5EIUcGUzfD.Name: pastureFracC4
recgt8Y5EIUcGUzfD.Title: C4 Pasture Area Percentage

recgupWDXPpNOxWEF.Description: Tendency of heat content for a grid cell from all processes. Reported only for models that use conservative temperature as prognostic field.
recgupWDXPpNOxWEF.Name: ocontemptend
recgupWDXPpNOxWEF.Title: Tendency of Sea Water Conservative Temperature Expressed as Heat Content

rech2Z0V2b4sURyRv.Description: mass of ice water in the column divided by the area of the column (not just the area of the cloudy portion of the column). Includes precipitating frozen hydrometeors ONLY if the precipitating hydrometeor affects the calculation of radiative transfer in model.
rech2Z0V2b4sURyRv.Name: clivi
rech2Z0V2b4sURyRv.Title: Ice Water Path

rech8qXNACGue5Sxo.Description: The surface called "surface" means the lower boundary of the atmosphere.  "Sea water pressure" is the pressure that exists in the medium of sea water.  It includes the pressure due to overlying sea water, sea ice, air and any other medium that may be present.
rech8qXNACGue5Sxo.Name: pso
rech8qXNACGue5Sxo.Title: Sea Water Pressure at Sea Water Surface

rech9WSS6hTmMdJQt.Description: In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics. The surface called "surface" means the lower boundary of the atmosphere. "Surface snow and ice refreezing flux" means the mass flux of surface  meltwater which refreezes within the snow or firn.
rech9WSS6hTmMdJQt.Name: snrefr
rech9WSS6hTmMdJQt.Title: Refreezing of Water in the Snow

rechD8sHHXGh7AuUl.Description: The surface called "surface" means the lower boundary of the atmosphere. "Upward" indicates a vector component which is positive when directed upward (negative downward). The surface latent heat flux is the exchange of heat between the surface and the air on account of evaporation (including sublimation). In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics.
rechD8sHHXGh7AuUl.Name: hflsLut
rechD8sHHXGh7AuUl.Title: Latent Heat Flux on Land-Use Tile

rechJKfxXEcFEYOBp.Description: "Thickness" means the vertical extent of a layer. "Cell" refers to a model grid cell.
rechJKfxXEcFEYOBp.Name: slthick
rechJKfxXEcFEYOBp.Title: Thickness of Soil Layers

rechKM2BEgnhLiVIb.Description: Chlorophyll concentration from the diazotrophic phytoplankton component alone
rechKM2BEgnhLiVIb.Name: chldiaz
rechKM2BEgnhLiVIb.Title: Mass Concentration of Diazotrophs Expressed as Chlorophyll in Sea Water

rechQ1JXimWCHEKyO.Description: The precipitation flux that is intercepted by the vegetation canopy (if present in model) before reaching the ground.
rechQ1JXimWCHEKyO.Name: prveg
rechQ1JXimWCHEKyO.Title: Precipitation onto Canopy

rechTybdHr0FlntKx.Description: Total family (the sum of all appropriate species in the model) ; list the species in the netCDF header, e.g. Cly = HCl + ClONO2 + HOCl + ClO + Cl + 2\*Cl2O2 +2Cl2 + OClO + BrCl Definition: Total inorganic stratospheric chlorine (e.g., HCl, ClO) resulting from degradation of chlorine-containing source gases (CFCs, HCFCs, VSLS), and natural inorganic chlorine sources (e.g., sea salt and other aerosols) add comment attribute with detailed description about how the model calculates these fields
rechTybdHr0FlntKx.Name: cly
rechTybdHr0FlntKx.Title: Total Inorganic Chlorine Volume Mixing Ratio

rechWIiAHPErvJgEv.Description: The ice sheet mass is computed as the volume above flotation times density. Changes in land\_ice\_mass\_not\_displacing\_sea\_water will always result in a change in sea level, unlike changes in land\_ice\_mass which may not result in sea level change (such as melting of the floating ice shelves, or portion of ice that sits on bedrock below sea level)
rechWIiAHPErvJgEv.Name: limnsw
rechWIiAHPErvJgEv.Title: Ice Sheet Mass That Does not Displace Sea Water

rechWUx1YmlzdktqQ.Name: froc
rechWUx1YmlzdktqQ.Title: Downward Organic Carbon Flux at Ocean Bottom

rechYJ7l8szKLRab2.Description: Change over time of the mass of water per unit area in the fluvial system (stream and floodplain).
rechYJ7l8szKLRab2.Name: drivw
rechYJ7l8szKLRab2.Title: Change in River Storage

rechZ3VeJ19RB7fXP.Description: Total aerosol AOD due to sea salt aerosol at a wavelength of 550 nanometres.
rechZ3VeJ19RB7fXP.Name: od550ss
rechZ3VeJ19RB7fXP.Title: Sea-Salt Aerosol Optical Depth at 550nm

rechcHdsHvwD3FPUi.Description: 'Mole concentration' means number of moles per unit volume, also called "molarity", and is used in the construction mole\_concentration\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.  A chemical or biological species denoted by X may be described by a single term such as 'nitrogen' or a phrase such as 'nox\_expressed\_as\_nitrogen'. The concentration of any chemical species, whether particulate or dissolved, may vary with depth in the ocean.  A depth profile may go through one or more local minima in concentration. The mole\_concentration\_of\_molecular\_oxygen\_in\_sea\_water\_at\_shallowest\_local\_minimum\_in\_vertical\_profile is the mole concentration of oxygen at the local minimum in the concentration profile that occurs closest to the sea surface.
rechcHdsHvwD3FPUi.Name: o2min
rechcHdsHvwD3FPUi.Title: Oxygen Minimum Concentration

rechdyk3FwsVVOYdt.Description: Total cloud area fraction (reported as a percentage) for the whole atmospheric column, as seen from the surface or the top of the atmosphere. Includes both large-scale and convective cloud.
rechdyk3FwsVVOYdt.Name: clt
rechdyk3FwsVVOYdt.Title: Total Cloud Cover Percentage

rechj6w2cH4TkbTq6.Description: Growth limitation of diazotrophs due to solar irradiance. "Growth limitation due to solar irradiance" means the ratio of the growth rate of a species population in the environment (where the amount of sunlight reaching a location may be limited) to the theoretical growth rate if there were no such limit on solar irradiance.
rechj6w2cH4TkbTq6.Name: limirrdiaz
rechj6w2cH4TkbTq6.Title: Irradiance Limitation of Diazotrophs

rechjPs0qALyVIxOV.Name: h2loss
rechjPs0qALyVIxOV.Title: Loss of H2 due to chemical destruction

rechnt3W9lPzi4gfX.Description: A velocity is a vector quantity. "Upward" indicates a vector component which is positive when directed upward (negative downward). "basal" means the lower boundary of the atmosphere
rechnt3W9lPzi4gfX.Name: zvelbase
rechnt3W9lPzi4gfX.Title: Upward Component of Land-Ice Basal Velocity

rechpyMUUKB1U9yDz.Description: Mole fraction is used in the construction mole\_fraction\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.
rechpyMUUKB1U9yDz.Name: hcho
rechpyMUUKB1U9yDz.Title: Formaldehyde Volume Mixing Ratio

rechxBSmuy1Fp7q4d.Description: Upper boundary temperature that is used to force ice sheet models. It is the temperature at the base of the snowpack models, and does not vary with seasons. Report surface temperature of ice sheet where snow thickness is zero
rechxBSmuy1Fp7q4d.Name: litemptop
rechxBSmuy1Fp7q4d.Title: Temperature at Top of Ice Sheet Model

rechyZ85pjHyKRYNi.Description: Tendency of zonally averaged eastward wind, by the residual northward wind advection (on the native model grid). Reference: Andrews et al (1987): Middle Atmospheric Dynamics. Academic Press.
rechyZ85pjHyKRYNi.Name: utendvtem
rechyZ85pjHyKRYNi.Title: Tendency of Eastward Wind Due to TEM Northward Advection and Coriolis Term

reci4Hue8y0n9pU2E.Description: Percentage of grid cell covered by grounded ice sheet
reci4Hue8y0n9pU2E.Name: sftgrf
reci4Hue8y0n9pU2E.Title: Grounded Ice Sheet Area Percentage

reci4ztSeC8ylc01o.Description: Sea water conservative temperature (this should be contributed only for models using conservative temperature as prognostic field)
reci4ztSeC8ylc01o.Name: bigthetao
reci4ztSeC8ylc01o.Processing Comment: This variable should be contributed only for models using conservative temperature as prognostic field.
reci4ztSeC8ylc01o.Title: Sea Water Conservative Temperature

reciAa8lX8IHEl0Rr.Description: This annual mean flux refers to the transfer of carbon directly to the atmosphere due to any land-use or land-cover change activities.  Include carbon transferred due to deforestation or agricultural directly into atmosphere, and  emissions form anthropogenic pools into atmosphere
reciAa8lX8IHEl0Rr.Name: fLulccAtmLut
reciAa8lX8IHEl0Rr.Title: Carbon Transferred Directly to Atmosphere Due to any Land-Use or Land-Cover Change Activities [kgC m-2 s-1]

reciGKQfX7Pk5edxY.Description: The surface called "surface" means the lower boundary of the atmosphere. The partial pressure of a dissolved gas in sea water is the partial pressure in air with which it would be in equilibrium. The partial pressure of a gaseous constituent of air is the pressure which it alone would exert with unchanged temperature and number of moles per unit volume. The chemical formula for carbon dioxide is CO2.
reciGKQfX7Pk5edxY.Name: spco2
reciGKQfX7Pk5edxY.Title: Surface Aqueous Partial Pressure of CO2

reciHRxOCaqj2b1Bx.Description: This is the sum of total emission of primary organic aerosol (POA) and total production of secondary organic aerosol (SOA) (emipoa+chepsoa). Here, mass refers to the mass of organic matter, not mass of organic carbon alone. We recommend a scale factor of POM=1.4\*OC, unless your model has more detailed info available.  Integrate 3D chemical production and emission field vertically to 2d field.
reciHRxOCaqj2b1Bx.Name: emioa
reciHRxOCaqj2b1Bx.Title: Primary Emission and Chemical Production of Dry Aerosol Organic Matter

reciHwUruwCByoQie.Description: In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics. The specification of a physical process by the phrase "due\_to\_" process means that the quantity named is a single term in a sum of terms which together compose the general quantity named by omitting the phrase. "Leaching" means the loss of water soluble chemical species from soil. Runoff is the liquid water which drains from land. If not specified, "runoff" refers to the sum of surface runoff and subsurface drainage.
reciHwUruwCByoQie.Name: fNleach
reciHwUruwCByoQie.Title: Total Nitrogen Loss to Leaching or Runoff (Sum of Ammonium, Nitrite and Nitrate)

reciI96ptsjjH6vbq.Description: Vertically integrated primary (organic carbon) production by the calcareous phytoplankton component alone
reciI96ptsjjH6vbq.Name: intppcalc
reciI96ptsjjH6vbq.Title: Net Primary Mole Productivity of Carbon by Calcareous Phytoplankton

reciJs5KknTsJXPAb.Description: The net mass flux  represents the difference between the updraft and downdraft components.   This is calculated as the convective mass flux divided by the area of the whole grid cell (not just the area of the cloud).
reciJs5KknTsJXPAb.Name: dmc
reciJs5KknTsJXPAb.Title: Deep Convective Mass Flux

reciR5KkawnYV7NLu.Description: Total mass of all salt in sea ice divided by grid-cell area. Sometimes, models implicitly or explicitly assume a different salinity of the ice for thermodynamic considerations than they do for closing the salt budget with the ocean. In these cases, the total mass of all salt in sea ice should be calculated from the salinity value used in the calculation of the salt budget.
reciR5KkawnYV7NLu.Name: sisaltmass
reciR5KkawnYV7NLu.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Title and Description - CMIP6: Mass of Salt in Sea Ice per Area, CMIP7: Mass of Salt in Sea Ice
reciR5KkawnYV7NLu.Title: Mass of Salt in Sea Ice

reciXwmPmRf2558v4.Description: Aerosol volume extinction coefficient at 550nm wavelength.
reciXwmPmRf2558v4.Name: ec550aer
reciXwmPmRf2558v4.Title: Aerosol Extinction Coefficient

recicptXtzbcTjwAR.Description: Total mass of snow on sea ice divided by grid-cell area. This then allows one to analyse the storage of latent heat in the snow, and to calculate the snow-water equivalent.
recicptXtzbcTjwAR.Name: sisnmass
recicptXtzbcTjwAR.Title: Snow Mass per Area

recij8KfjMZ5PboRm.Description: The time varying thickness of ocean cells centered at v-points (points for velocity in the y-direction). "Thickness" means the vertical extent of a layer. "Cell" refers to a model grid-cell.
recij8KfjMZ5PboRm.Name: thkcellvo
recij8KfjMZ5PboRm.Title: Ocean Model Cell Thickness at v-points

reciovasE59pruncI.Description: The total surface mass balance flux over land ice is a spatial integration of the surface mass balance flux
reciovasE59pruncI.Name: tendacabf
reciovasE59pruncI.Title: Total Surface Mass Balance Flux

reciulIyyFnWRkj3s.Description: Mole concentration means moles (amount of substance) per unit volume and is used in the construction mole\_concentration\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.
reciulIyyFnWRkj3s.Name: nh4os
reciulIyyFnWRkj3s.Title: Surface Dissolved Ammonium Concentration

recixFMi8LSYpu1zu.Description: Report missing data over ocean grid cells. For fractional land report value averaged over the land fraction.
recixFMi8LSYpu1zu.Name: cSoilAbove1m
recixFMi8LSYpu1zu.Title: Carbon Mass in Soil Pool Above 1m Depth

reciyw2hNHTt9ZB5m.Description: Near surface dissolved inorganic carbon-13 (CO3+HCO3+H2CO3) concentration
reciyw2hNHTt9ZB5m.Name: dissi13cos
reciyw2hNHTt9ZB5m.Title: Surface Dissolved Inorganic Carbon-13 Concentration

recj35ZYq3IleS9D5.Description: Surface temperature of all surfaces except open ocean.
recj35ZYq3IleS9D5.Name: tslsi
recj35ZYq3IleS9D5.Title: Surface Temperature Where Land or Sea Ice

recj37B3ISiUTmmEM.Description: X-component of the force on sea ice caused by the Coriolis force divided by grid-cell area.
recj37B3ISiUTmmEM.Name: siforcecoriolx
recj37B3ISiUTmmEM.Title: Coriolis Force Term in Force Balance (X-Component)

recj3dcULauDcbY9b.Name: ccn
recj3dcULauDcbY9b.Title: Cloud Condensation Nuclei Concentration at Liquid Cloud Top

recj4VW3YfR8ipLuX.Description: Ocean tracer diffusivity associated with parameterized eddy-induced diffusive transport oriented along neutral or isopycnal directions. Sometimes this diffusivity is called the neutral diffusivity or isopycnal diffusivity or Redi diffusivity.
recj4VW3YfR8ipLuX.Name: diftrelo
recj4VW3YfR8ipLuX.Title: Ocean Tracer Epineutral Laplacian Diffusivity

recj5MsA9DmKdiq5w.Description: Carbon mass per unit area in that has been removed from the environment through  land use change.
recj5MsA9DmKdiq5w.Name: cProduct
recj5MsA9DmKdiq5w.Title: Carbon Mass in Products of Land-Use Change

recj5R1yI0qlvogkl.Description: Iron supply through deposition flux onto sea surface, runoff, coasts, sediments, etc
recj5R1yI0qlvogkl.Name: fsfe
recj5R1yI0qlvogkl.Title: Surface Downward Net Flux of Iron

recj7TxsNptNEeHrA.Description: Depth is the vertical distance below the surface. The water table is the surface below which the soil is saturated with water such that all pore spaces are filled.
recj7TxsNptNEeHrA.Name: wtd
recj7TxsNptNEeHrA.Title: Water Table Depth

recj8Bm2q41laxku4.Description: Carbon-13 mass content per unit area litter (dead plant material in or above the soil).
recj8Bm2q41laxku4.Name: c13Litter
recj8Bm2q41laxku4.Title: Mass of 13C in Litter Pool

recjAnQxEjyudzz8G.Description: Full column sum of density\*cell thickness\*conservative temperature. If the model is Boussinesq, then use Boussinesq reference density for the density factor.
recjAnQxEjyudzz8G.Name: ocontempmint
recjAnQxEjyudzz8G.Title: Depth Integral of Product of Sea Water Density and Conservative Temperature

recjB5MepaVtjr2xu.Description: Conservative Temperature is defined as part of the Thermodynamic Equation of Seawater 2010 (TEOS-10) which was adopted in 2010 by the International Oceanographic Commission (IOC). The phrase "residual mean advection" refers to the sum of the model's resolved advective transport plus any parameterized advective transport. Parameterized advective transport includes processes such as parameterized mesoscale and submesoscale transport, as well as any other advectively parameterized transport. When the parameterized advective transport is represented in the model as a skew-diffusion rather than an advection, then the parameterized skew diffusion should be included in this diagnostic, since the convergence of skew-fluxes are identical (in the continuous formulation) to the convergence of advective fluxes.
recjB5MepaVtjr2xu.Name: ocontemprmadvect
recjB5MepaVtjr2xu.Title: Tendency of Sea Water Conservative Temperature Expressed as Heat Content Due to Residual Mean Advection

recjC5MhiY6Ksqvwd.Description: Runoff is the liquid water which drains from land. If not specified, "runoff" refers to the sum of surface runoff and subsurface drainage. In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics.
recjC5MhiY6Ksqvwd.Name: mrrob
recjC5MhiY6Ksqvwd.Title: Subsurface Runoff

recjCLUvaFSDRqVy0.Description: Sigma T is potential density referenced to ocean surface. Defined by Sigma T of 0.03 kg m-3 wrt to model level closest to 10 m depth.
recjCLUvaFSDRqVy0.Name: mlotst
recjCLUvaFSDRqVy0.Title: Ocean Mixed Layer Thickness Defined by Sigma T of 0.03 kg m-3

recjGBCJ3ZUVoFdEE.Description: The phrase 'expressed\_as' is used in the construction A\_expressed\_as\_B, where B is a chemical constituent of A. It means that the quantity indicated by the standard name is calculated solely with respect to the B contained in A, neglecting all other chemical constituents of A. In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics.   'Sinking' is the gravitational settling of particulate matter suspended in a liquid. A sinking flux is positive downwards and is calculated relative to the movement of the surrounding fluid. Calcite is a mineral that is a polymorph of calcium carbonate. The chemical formula of calcite is CaCO3. Standard names also exist for aragonite, another polymorph of calcium carbonate.
recjGBCJ3ZUVoFdEE.Name: epcalc100
recjGBCJ3ZUVoFdEE.Title: Downward Flux of Calcite

recjHyix6Eq0zJPG1.Description: AOD from the ambient aerosols in clear skies if od550aer is for all-sky (i.e., includes aerosol water).  Does not include AOD from stratospheric aerosols if these are prescribed but includes other possible background aerosol types. Needs a comment attribute "wavelength: 550nm"
recjHyix6Eq0zJPG1.Name: od550csaer
recjHyix6Eq0zJPG1.Processing Comment: NOTE - change in CF standard name since CMIP6. New standard name was proposed late, so may not be accepted in time for the v1.2.2 release. Data providers to check.
recjHyix6Eq0zJPG1.Title: Ambient Aerosol Optical Thickness at 550nm

recjU2hcaxi23SO6R.Description: Includes all boundary layer terms including diffusive terms.
recjU2hcaxi23SO6R.Name: tnhuspbl
recjU2hcaxi23SO6R.Title: Tendency of Specific Humidity Due to Boundary Layer Mixing

recjURBLjfZbxfVUc.Description: Depth integrated impacts on kinetic energy arising from parameterized eddy-induced advection. For CMIP5, this diagnostic was 3d, whereas the CMIP6 depth integrated diagnostic is sufficient for many purposes and reduces archive requirements.
recjURBLjfZbxfVUc.Name: tnkebto
recjURBLjfZbxfVUc.Title: Tendency of Ocean Eddy Kinetic Energy Content Due to Parameterized Eddy Advection

recjUlFbqhinnKgMa.Description: Actual (floe) thickness of sea ice in each ice thickness category, NOT volume divided by grid area (vector with one entry for each ice thickness category starting from the thinnest category, netcdf file should use thickness bounds of categories as third coordinate axis).
recjUlFbqhinnKgMa.Name: siitdthick
recjUlFbqhinnKgMa.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Title - CMIP6: Sea-Ice Thickness in Thickness Categories, CMIP7: Sea-Ice Thickness in Ice Thickness Categories
recjUlFbqhinnKgMa.Title: Sea-Ice Thickness in Ice Thickness Categories

recjVxcDRwQ1FNpWU.Description: Total Nitrogen added for cropland fertilisation (artificial and manure). Relative to total land area of a grid cell, not relative to agricultural area
recjVxcDRwQ1FNpWU.Name: fNfert
recjVxcDRwQ1FNpWU.Title: Total Nitrogen Added for Cropland Fertilisation (Artificial and Manure)

recjbxvKBxG6w6cfi.Description: Overturning mass streamfunction arising from all advective mass transport processes, resolved and parameterized.
recjbxvKBxG6w6cfi.Name: msftmz
recjbxvKBxG6w6cfi.Title: Ocean Meridional Overturning Mass Streamfunction

recjfAgiOJM5tQYKu.Description: Diagnostic should be contributed even for models using conservative temperature as prognostic field.
recjfAgiOJM5tQYKu.Name: thetao
recjfAgiOJM5tQYKu.Title: Sea Water Potential Temperature

recjnrTr2ngAg7qCP.Description: In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics.  The specification of a physical process by the phrase due\_to\_process means that the quantity named is a  single term in a sum of terms which together compose the general quantity  named by omitting the phrase.  "Snow thermodynamics" refers to the addition or subtraction of mass due to surface and basal fluxes, i.e., due to melting, sublimation and fusion.
recjnrTr2ngAg7qCP.Name: hfsnthermds
recjnrTr2ngAg7qCP.Title: Heat Flux into Sea Water Due to Snow Thermodynamics

recjpUAubo1kOsmvY.Description: Sea water salinity is the salt content of sea water, often on the Practical Salinity Scale of 1978. However, the unqualified term 'salinity' is generic and does not necessarily imply any particular method of calculation. The units of salinity are dimensionless and the units attribute should normally be given as 1e-3 or 0.001 i.e. parts per thousand.
recjpUAubo1kOsmvY.Name: so
recjpUAubo1kOsmvY.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Units - CMIP6:1 CMIP7:1E-03
recjpUAubo1kOsmvY.Title: Sea Water Salinity

recjq8L4RZwJwMhhD.Description: "Content" indicates a quantity per unit area. "Wood debris" means dead organic matter composed of coarse wood. It is distinct from fine litter. The precise distinction between "fine" and "coarse" is model dependent.
recjq8L4RZwJwMhhD.Name: cLitterCwd
recjq8L4RZwJwMhhD.Title: Carbon Mass in Coarse Woody Debris

recjum8wQlyEgyL2l.Name: emibbch4
recjum8wQlyEgyL2l.Title: total emission of CH4 from all biomass burning

recjvBWsJcG1P4dOY.Name: ccn1
recjvBWsJcG1P4dOY.Title: CCN concentration at 1.0 percent supersaturation, based on aerosol chemical composition and size

reck0mR9UOes42WDP.Description: Droplets are liquid.  The effective radius is defined as the ratio of the third moment over the second moment of the particle size distribution and the time-mean should be calculated, weighting the individual samples by the cloudy fraction of the grid cell.
reck0mR9UOes42WDP.Name: reffclws
reck0mR9UOes42WDP.Title: Stratiform Cloud Liquid Droplet Effective Radius

reck6BDiXgGlyVADe.Description: Dry Deposition includes gravitational settling and turbulent deposition
reck6BDiXgGlyVADe.Name: drynh3
reck6BDiXgGlyVADe.Title: Dry Deposition Rate of NH3

reckBOsq47KTftRhT.Name: expcob
reckBOsq47KTftRhT.Title: Sinking Flux of Particulate Organic Carbon Reaching the Ocean Bottom

reckE2VSt91eodCeg.Description: Upward sensible heat flux on land use tiles. The surface sensible heat flux, also called turbulent heat flux, is the exchange of heat between the surface and the air by motion of air.
reckE2VSt91eodCeg.Name: hfssLut
reckE2VSt91eodCeg.Title: Sensible Heat Flux on Land-Use Tile

reckH8wWoyub6U9f0.Description: The total calving flux over land ice is a spatial integration of the calving flux
reckH8wWoyub6U9f0.Name: tendlicalvf
reckH8wWoyub6U9f0.Title: Total Calving Flux

reckIrTPZBo3CeqjW.Description: Surface solar irradiance for UV calculations
reckIrTPZBo3CeqjW.Name: rsdsIs
reckIrTPZBo3CeqjW.Title: Ice Sheet Surface Downwelling Shortwave Radiation

reckPt14zg4f0lePm.Description: The bedrock topography beneath the land ice
reckPt14zg4f0lePm.Name: topg
reckPt14zg4f0lePm.Title: Bedrock Altitude

reckSItOE5MEBEXz8.Description: Temperature of the snow surface as it interacts with the atmosphere, averaged over a grid cell.
reckSItOE5MEBEXz8.Name: tsns
reckSItOE5MEBEXz8.Title: Snow Surface Temperature

reckSOVf6R8vczRgt.Description: Total volume of sea ice divided by grid-cell area, also known as the equivalent thickness of sea ice.
reckSOVf6R8vczRgt.Name: sivol
reckSOVf6R8vczRgt.Title: Sea-Ice Volume per Area

reckTnapbC61FlRpj.Description: Tendency of the eastward wind by parameterized nonorographic gravity waves.
reckTnapbC61FlRpj.Name: utendnogw
reckTnapbC61FlRpj.Title: Eastward Acceleration Due to Non-Orographic Gravity Wave Drag

reckX9qieK0niOZDd.Description: In ocean modelling, diazotrophs are phytoplankton of the phylum cyanobacteria distinct from other phytoplankton groups in their ability to fix nitrogen gas in addition to nitrate and ammonium. Phytoplankton are algae that grow where there is sufficient light to support photosynthesis. "Iron growth limitation" means the ratio of the growth rate of a species population in the environment (where there is a finite availability of iron) to the theoretical growth rate if there were no such limit on iron availability.
reckX9qieK0niOZDd.Name: limfediaz
reckX9qieK0niOZDd.Title: Iron Limitation of Diazotrophs

reckZLj2ZeMbAwQ0A.Description: total organic aerosol AOD due to biomass burning (excluding so4, nitrate BB components)
reckZLj2ZeMbAwQ0A.Name: od550bb
reckZLj2ZeMbAwQ0A.Processing Comment: NOTE - change in CF standard name since CMIP6. New standard name was proposed late, so may not be accepted in time for the v1.2.2 release. Data providers to check.
reckZLj2ZeMbAwQ0A.Title: Aerosol Optical Depth at 550nm Due to Biomass Burning

reckdSWRicpztw5Ml.Description: Mole concentration of dimethyl sulphide in water in the near surface layer
reckdSWRicpztw5Ml.Name: dmsos
reckdSWRicpztw5Ml.Title: Surface Mole Concentration of Dimethyl Sulphide in Sea Water

reckenAHA8mkURECQ.Description: Calculated as the mass of convective cloud ice  in the grid cell divided by the mass of air (including the water in all phases) in the grid cell.  This includes precipitating hydrometeors ONLY if the precipitating hydrometeors affect the calculation of radiative transfer in model.
reckenAHA8mkURECQ.Name: clic
reckenAHA8mkURECQ.Title: Mass Fraction of Convective Cloud Ice

reckf35taXC3kxcUV.Description: Sum of chlorophyll from all phytoplankton group concentrations.  In most models this is equal to chldiat+chlmisc, that is the sum of Diatom Chlorophyll Mass Concentration and Other Phytoplankton Chlorophyll Mass Concentration
reckf35taXC3kxcUV.Name: chl
reckf35taXC3kxcUV.Title: Mass Concentration of Total Phytoplankton Expressed as Chlorophyll in Sea Water

reckfhxjqvJYkjulu.Description: Percentage of each grid cell that is occupied by snow that rests on land portion of cell.
reckfhxjqvJYkjulu.Name: snc
reckfhxjqvJYkjulu.Title: Snow Area Percentage

recksrCizNU3OV7KQ.Description: Mole fraction is used in the construction mole\_fraction\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.  The chemical formula of CFC113 is CCl2FCClF2.  The IUPAC name for CFC113 is 1,1,2-trichloro-1,2,2-trifluoro-ethane.
recksrCizNU3OV7KQ.Name: cfc113global
recksrCizNU3OV7KQ.Title: Global Mean Mole Fraction of CFC113

recku6TjemXXxYRKA.Description: Depth of lakes, if this quantity is present in the model. If computed via volume and area, then this is lake volume divided by lake area.
recku6TjemXXxYRKA.Name: depthl
recku6TjemXXxYRKA.Title: Depth of Lake Below the Surface

reckx4zSrCEjus6l7.Description: carbon  concentration from the microzooplankton (<20 um) component alone
reckx4zSrCEjus6l7.Name: zmicroos
reckx4zSrCEjus6l7.Title: Surface Mole Concentration of Microzooplankton Expressed as Carbon in Sea Water

recl3NoUHSqKnpoCE.Description: Residual mass streamfunction, computed from vstar and integrated from the top of the atmosphere (on the native model grid). Reference: Andrews et al (1987): Middle Atmospheric Dynamics. Academic Press.
recl3NoUHSqKnpoCE.Name: psitem
recl3NoUHSqKnpoCE.Title: Transformed Eulerian Mean Mass Streamfunction

recl3RFFB7waL9a7W.Description: Cloud Droplet Number Concentration in liquid water clouds.
recl3RFFB7waL9a7W.Name: cdnc
recl3RFFB7waL9a7W.Title: Cloud Liquid Droplet Number Concentration

recl3XYOJY1evo03f.Description: Percentage of grid cell burned due to all fires including natural and anthropogenic fires and those associated with anthropogenic Land-use change
recl3XYOJY1evo03f.Name: burntFractionAll
recl3XYOJY1evo03f.Title: Percentage of Entire Grid Cell That Is Covered by Burnt Vegetation (All Classes)

recl5KPGErv9ZoQLK.Description: Vertically-integrated content of carbon in ice algae, expressed as moles of carbon per square meter of sea ice.
recl5KPGErv9ZoQLK.Name: sialgc
recl5KPGErv9ZoQLK.Title: Total Ice Algal Carbon Amount in Sea Ice

recl5RIo627OwuOtm.Description: Precipitation mass flux of water molecules that contain the oxygen-18 isotope (H2 18O), including solid and liquid phases.
recl5RIo627OwuOtm.Name: pr18O
recl5RIo627OwuOtm.Title: Precipitation Flux of Water Containing Oxygen-18 (H2 18O)

recl8aAErkNC7ae5b.Description: Report missing data over ocean grid cells. For fractional land report value averaged over the land fraction.
recl8aAErkNC7ae5b.Name: nSoil
recl8aAErkNC7ae5b.Title: Nitrogen Mass in Soil Pool

recl8kMStGa1sijW2.Description: Upward shortwave flux from the sea-ice surface to the atmosphere (energy flow per sea ice area). Always positive or zero.
recl8kMStGa1sijW2.Name: siflswutop
recl8kMStGa1sijW2.Title: Upwelling Shortwave Flux over Sea Ice

reclBSMketaknAokb.Description: Report missing data over ocean grid cells. For fractional land report value averaged over the land fraction.
reclBSMketaknAokb.Name: cLand
reclBSMketaknAokb.Title: Total Carbon in All Terrestrial Carbon Pools

reclEbmn2KWvWlQTN.Description: Total organic aerosol AOD due to secondary aerosol  at a wavelength of 550 nanometres.
reclEbmn2KWvWlQTN.Name: od550soa
reclEbmn2KWvWlQTN.Processing Comment: NOTE - change in CF standard name since CMIP6. New standard name was proposed late, so may not be accepted in time for the v1.2.2 release. Data providers to check.
reclEbmn2KWvWlQTN.Title: Particulate Organic Aerosol Optical Depth at 550nm

reclEjTbBJ7ZscXWF.Description: Total aerosol AOD due to organic aerosol at a wavelength of 550 nanometres.
reclEjTbBJ7ZscXWF.Name: od550oa
reclEjTbBJ7ZscXWF.Title: Total Organic Aerosol Optical Depth at 550nm

reclHm0xG410cGXkx.Name: exppob
reclHm0xG410cGXkx.Title: Downward sinking flux of particulate organic phosphorus at sea floor

reclHtDladUhexqNQ.Description: Cumulative percentage transitions over the year; note that percentage should be reported as a percentage of atmospheric grid cell
reclHtDladUhexqNQ.Name: fracInLut
reclHtDladUhexqNQ.Title: Annual Gross Percentage That Was Transferred into This Tile from Other Land-Use Tiles

reclOW7KzU0PKW0JN.Description: Mole fraction is used in the construction mole\_fraction\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.  The chemical formula of hydrogen chloride is HCl.
reclOW7KzU0PKW0JN.Name: hcl
reclOW7KzU0PKW0JN.Title: HCl Volume Mixing Ratio

reclWFH2ZDGoPzWU5.Description: end of year values (not annual mean)
reclWFH2ZDGoPzWU5.Name: cVegLut
reclWFH2ZDGoPzWU5.Title: Carbon in Vegetation on Land-Use Tiles

reclc8kj04GSInby6.Description: Tendency of Air Temperature due to Advection
reclc8kj04GSInby6.Name: tnta
reclc8kj04GSInby6.Title: Tendency of Air Temperature Due to Advection

reclcYdkKItC7yZyQ.Description: Loss of ice mass resulting from surface melting. Computed as the total surface melt water on the land ice portion of the grid cell divided by land ice area in the grid cell.
reclcYdkKItC7yZyQ.Name: icem
reclcYdkKItC7yZyQ.Title: Surface Ice Melt Flux

recldVncOh1DWoTui.Description: The phrase "tendency\_of\_X" means derivative of X with respect to time. Air temperature is the bulk temperature of the air, not the surface (skin) temperature. The specification of a physical process by the phrase "due\_to\_" process means that the quantity named is a single term in a sum of terms which together compose the general quantity named by omitting the phrase. A variable with the standard name tendency\_of\_air\_temperature\_due\_to\_stratiform\_cloud\_and\_precipitation should contain net latent heating effects of all processes which convert stratiform clouds and precipitation between water vapour, liquid or ice phases. In an atmosphere model, stratiform cloud is that produced by large-scale convergence (not the convection schemes).
recldVncOh1DWoTui.Name: tntscp
recldVncOh1DWoTui.Title: Tendency of Air Temperature Due to Stratiform Clouds and Precipitation

recldhcRfqovxHbxE.Name: rsutch4ref
recldhcRfqovxHbxE.Title: Top of atmosphere shortwave outgoing radiation from a diagnostic call with a reference methane field

reclilGD3yKm7JF5H.Description: A variable with the standard name of region contains strings which indicate geographical regions. These strings must be chosen from the standard region list.
reclilGD3yKm7JF5H.Name: basin
reclilGD3yKm7JF5H.Title: Region Selection Index

reclilJ00KA7HQC7M.Description: Age of Snow (when computing the time-mean here, the time samples, weighted by the mass of snow on the land portion of the grid cell, are accumulated and then divided by the sum of the weights.  Reported as missing data in regions free of snow on land.
reclilJ00KA7HQC7M.Name: agesno
reclilJ00KA7HQC7M.Title: Mean Age of Snow

reclk8X5P8x9mwIZx.Description: Fixed surface layer mixing ratio over 30o-50oN (100ppbv), uniform fixed 50-day exponential decay.
reclk8X5P8x9mwIZx.Name: nh50
reclk8X5P8x9mwIZx.Title: Artificial Tracer with 50 Day Lifetime

reclpQCTbyu9XxdEY.Description: Average height of the highest one-third of waves present in the sea state, incorporating just swell waves (i.e., waves that have propagated away from their generation area). This parameter is derived from all swell partitions of the wave spectrum using spectral moments. Specifically, this parameter is four times the square root of the integral over all directions and all frequencies of the components of the two-dimensional wave spectrum that are not under the influence of local wind.
reclpQCTbyu9XxdEY.Name: swhswell
reclpQCTbyu9XxdEY.Title: Swell Significant Wave Height

reclqeXK8T5FXTHWf.Description: Total RA of trees in the grid cell
reclqeXK8T5FXTHWf.Name: raTree
reclqeXK8T5FXTHWf.Title: Autotrophic Respiration on Tree Tiles as Carbon Mass Flux [kgC m-2 s-1]

reclx9Mzvw29e21aW.Description: Store flux as Nitrogen. Anthropogenic fraction. NOx=NO+NO2, Includes agricultural waste burning but no other biomass burning. Integrate 3D emission field vertically to 2d field.
reclx9Mzvw29e21aW.Name: emianox
reclx9Mzvw29e21aW.Title: Total Emission Rate of Anthropogenic NOx

reclyWVrmTPIFZmB3.Description: When land use change results in deforestation of natural vegetation (trees or grasslands) then natural biomass is removed. The treatment of deforested biomass differs significantly across models, but it should be straight-forward to compare deforested biomass across models.
reclyWVrmTPIFZmB3.Name: fNProduct
reclyWVrmTPIFZmB3.Title: Deforested or Harvested Biomass as a Result of Anthropogenic Land-Use or Change

recm2afVouQ3hGLPe.Description: Upwelling shortwave radiation  (includes also the fluxes at the surface and top of atmosphere)
recm2afVouQ3hGLPe.Name: rsu
recm2afVouQ3hGLPe.Title: Upwelling Shortwave Radiation

recm5DxJ4XTaKBjii.Description: Droplets are liquid only.  Values are weighted by liquid cloud fraction in each layer when vertically integrating, and for monthly means the samples are weighted by total liquid cloud fraction (as seen from TOA).
recm5DxJ4XTaKBjii.Name: cldnvi
recm5DxJ4XTaKBjii.Title: Column Integrated Cloud Droplet Number

recm5RWxG66JMkgSv.Description: This temperature is averaged over all the snow in the grid cell that rests on land or land ice.  When computing the time-mean here, the time samples, weighted by the mass of snow on the land portion of the grid cell, are accumulated and then divided by the sum of the weights.   Reported as missing in regions free of snow on land.
recm5RWxG66JMkgSv.Name: tsnIs
recm5RWxG66JMkgSv.Title: Ice Sheet Snow Internal Temperature

recm7Yj0eNCjYYXH9.Description: Downwelling shortwave radiation (includes the fluxes at the surface and top-of-atmosphere)
recm7Yj0eNCjYYXH9.Name: rsd
recm7Yj0eNCjYYXH9.Title: Downwelling Shortwave Radiation

recm9NKJUwuP39LQ1.Description: sum of particulate calcite component concentrations (e.g. Phytoplankton, Detrital, etc.)
recm9NKJUwuP39LQ1.Name: calcos
recm9NKJUwuP39LQ1.Title: Surface Calcite Concentration

recmCJaembhX5Y7mo.Description: Mean direction of wave propagation (direction from which the wave is coming) derived from the wind-sea component of the wave energy spectrum (i.e., local wind waves). This variable is usually expressed in degrees relative to true north.
recmCJaembhX5Y7mo.Name: wdirwindsea
recmCJaembhX5Y7mo.Title: Wind Sea Wave Direction

recmE48jYu7sCeNWQ.Description: Surface deposition rate of black carbon (dry mass) due to wet processes
recmE48jYu7sCeNWQ.Name: wetbc
recmE48jYu7sCeNWQ.Title: Wet Deposition Rate of Black Carbon Aerosol Mass

recmEZSmeh0hlci1I.Description: cloud\_top refers to the top of the highest cloud. Air temperature is the bulk temperature of the air, not the surface (skin) temperature.
recmEZSmeh0hlci1I.Name: ttop
recmEZSmeh0hlci1I.Title: Air Temperature at Cloud Top

recmIB5tDGzP4L3ri.Description: needed to separate changing vegetation C turnover times resulting from changing allocation versus changing mortality
recmIB5tDGzP4L3ri.Name: fVegSoilMortality
recmIB5tDGzP4L3ri.Title: Total Carbon Mass Flux from Vegetation to Soil as a Result of Mortality

recmIK12qNkhNbFUE.Description: Daily maximum near-surface (usually, 10 meters) wind speed.
recmIK12qNkhNbFUE.Name: sfcWindmax
recmIK12qNkhNbFUE.Title: Daily Maximum Near-Surface Wind Speed

recmNcjmt9X7iPiFZ.Description: Rate of change of sea-ice mass through melting/dissolution at the ice bottom divided by grid-cell area. Note that this number is always zero or negative since sea-ice growth is collected in sidmassgrowthbot. This is to account for differential growth and melt in models with a sub-grid scale ice thickness distribution.
recmNcjmt9X7iPiFZ.Name: sidmassmeltbot
recmNcjmt9X7iPiFZ.Title: Sea-Ice Mass Change Through Bottom Melting

recwinOGxg2x3PCr5.Title: Surface Mole Concentration of Mesozooplankton Expressed as Carbon in Sea Water

recwjM8agAmICbDio.Description: The linear extent of the cell in the y direction of the horizontal grid centered at u-points (points for velocity in the x-direction). Not applicable to unstructured grids.
recwjM8agAmICbDio.Name: dyuo
recwjM8agAmICbDio.Title: Cell Length in the Y Direction at u-points

recwl9fFWcIayEzBx.Description: Heat content of all ice in grid cell divided by grid-cell area. This includes both the latent and sensible heat content contributions. Water at 0C is assumed to have a heat content of 0 J. This variable does not include heat content of snow, but does include heat content of brine. Heat content is always negative since both the sensible and the latent heat content of ice are less than that of water.
recwl9fFWcIayEzBx.Name: sihc
recwl9fFWcIayEzBx.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Title and Description - CMIP6: Sea-Ice Heat Content per Unit Area, CMIP7: Sea-Ice Heat Content. CHANGE In CF Standard Name - CMIP6: sea_ice_temperature_expressed_as_heat_content, CMIP7: sea_ice_enthalpy_content
recwl9fFWcIayEzBx.Title: Sea-Ice Heat Content

recwnGeUfiT54S5rS.Description: convective precipitation of all forms of water in the solid phase.
recwnGeUfiT54S5rS.Name: prsnc
recwnGeUfiT54S5rS.Title: Convective Snowfall Flux

recwwGGo9xxX8mhCC.Description: Mean temperature at the snow-ice interface. This is the surface temperature of ice where snow thickness is zero.
recwwGGo9xxX8mhCC.Name: sitempsnic
recwwGGo9xxX8mhCC.Title: Temperature at Snow-Ice Interface

recwxoeC2JU4vLwce.Description: Percentage of entire grid cell  that is land and is covered by  neither vegetation nor bare-soil (e.g., urban, ice, lakes, etc.)
recwxoeC2JU4vLwce.Name: residualFrac
recwxoeC2JU4vLwce.Title: Percentage of Grid Cell That Is Land but neither Vegetation Covered nor Bare Soil

recx0rHOsf0Vie7vR.Description: Temperature of soil. Reported as missing for grid cells with no land.
recx0rHOsf0Vie7vR.Name: tsl
recx0rHOsf0Vie7vR.Title: Temperature of Soil

recx4aG8qQVlD6uJR.Name: vaUTLS
recx4aG8qQVlD6uJR.Title: 6 hourly instantaneous northward wind at 5 pressure levels in the UTLS region (150, 175, 200, 225, and 250 hPa)

recx6yaCCpHZPqjWa.Description: The linear extent of the cell in the y direction of the horizontal grid centered at t-points (points for tracers such as temperature, salinity, etc.). Not applicable to unstructured grids.
recx6yaCCpHZPqjWa.Name: dyto
recx6yaCCpHZPqjWa.Title: Cell Length in the Y Direction at t-points

recx8eYMGUbkym7rb.Description: Y-component of the ocean stress on the sea ice bottom divided by grid-cell area.
recx8eYMGUbkym7rb.Name: sistryubot
recx8eYMGUbkym7rb.Title: Y-Component of Ocean Stress on Sea Ice

recxEn1IbPop04cRY.Description: dissolved iron in sea water is meant to include both Fe2+ and Fe3+ ions (but not, e.g., particulate detrital iron)
recxEn1IbPop04cRY.Name: dfeos
recxEn1IbPop04cRY.Title: Surface Dissolved Iron Concentration

recxIdw70iVrMQYab.Description: Longitude is positive eastward; its units of degree\_east (or equivalent) indicate this explicitly. In a latitude-longitude system defined with respect to a rotated North Pole, the standard name of grid\_longitude should be used instead of longitude. Grid longitude is positive in the grid-eastward direction, but its units should be plain degree.
recxIdw70iVrMQYab.Name: lon
recxIdw70iVrMQYab.Title: Longitude

recxJU7zyFNbaMmsM.Description: The surface called "surface" means the lower boundary of the atmosphere. "Downward" indicates a vector component which is positive when directed downward (negative upward). The vertical heat flux in air is the sum of all heat fluxes i.e. radiative, latent and sensible. In accordance with common usage in geophysical disciplines, "flux" implies per unit area, called "flux density" in physics.
recxJU7zyFNbaMmsM.Name: hfdsl
recxJU7zyFNbaMmsM.Title: Downward Heat Flux at Land Surface

recxNAd9l9NCegx1U.Description: This is defined as the in-cloud ratio of the third moment over the second moment of the particle size distribution (obtained by considering only the cloudy portion of the grid cell).
recxNAd9l9NCegx1U.Name: reffclic
recxNAd9l9NCegx1U.Title: Hydrometeor Effective Radius of Convective Cloud Ice

recxNJPqCid8E76jA.Description: From all advective mass transport processes, resolved and parameterized.
recxNJPqCid8E76jA.Name: sltovovrt
recxNJPqCid8E76jA.Title: Northward Ocean Salt Transport Due to Overturning

recxO4KWMRTwXT56j.Name: tauunowgw
recxO4KWMRTwXT56j.Title: Eastward Reynolds stress from non-orographic westward gravity wave parameterization

recxSvVCmmutHec45.Description:
Negative log10 of hydrogen ion concentration with the concentration expressed as mol H kg-1.
Evaluated at the upper boundary of the liquid ocean, including at the lower boundary of sea-ice and floating ice shelves.
recxSvVCmmutHec45.Name: phos
recxSvVCmmutHec45.Title: Surface pH

recxUBT47zJW4rWKS.Description: Atmospheric drag coefficient that is used to calculate the atmospheric momentum drag on sea ice.
recxUBT47zJW4rWKS.Name: sidragtop
recxUBT47zJW4rWKS.Title: Atmospheric Drag Coefficient

recxVw0k5flwgU9vg.Description: subsurface litter pool fed by root inputs.
recxVw0k5flwgU9vg.Name: cLitterSubSurf
recxVw0k5flwgU9vg.Title: Carbon Mass in Below-Ground Litter

recxWn86SFqN7G7rQ.Description: Where convective cloud is present in the grid cell, the instantaneous cloud top altitude should be that of the top of the highest level containing convective cloud. Missing data should be reported in the absence of convective cloud. The time mean should be calculated from these quantities averaging over occasions when convective cloud is present only, and should contain missing data for occasions when no convective cloud is present during the meaning period.
recxWn86SFqN7G7rQ.Name: cct
recxWn86SFqN7G7rQ.Title: Air Pressure at Convective Cloud Top

recxXkAPeBwnXIpph.Description: The phrase "tendency\_of\_X" means derivative of X with respect to time. "Specific" means per unit mass. Specific humidity is the mass fraction of water vapor in (moist) air. The specification of a physical process by the phrase "due\_to\_" process means that the quantity named is a single term in a sum of terms which together compose the general quantity named by omitting the phrase. A variable with the standard name of tendency\_of\_specific\_humidity\_due\_to\_stratiform\_cloud\_and\_precipitation should contain the effects of all processes which convert stratiform clouds and precipitation to or from water vapor. In an atmosphere model, stratiform cloud is that produced by large-scale convergence (not the convection schemes).
recxXkAPeBwnXIpph.Name: tnhusscp
recxXkAPeBwnXIpph.Title: Tendency of Specific Humidity Due to Stratiform Clouds and Precipitation

recxc8bJ1NEn1DM7q.Description: Inorganic Carbon supply to ocean through runoff (separate from gas exchange)
recxc8bJ1NEn1DM7q.Name: icfriver
recxc8bJ1NEn1DM7q.Title: Flux of Inorganic Carbon into Ocean Surface by Runoff

recxnLzWz8gptt5G3.Description: The net mass flux represents the difference between the updraft and downdraft components.  For models with a distinct shallow convection scheme, this is calculated as convective mass flux divided by the area of the whole grid cell (not just the area of the cloud).
recxnLzWz8gptt5G3.Name: smc
recxnLzWz8gptt5G3.Title: Shallow Convective Mass Flux

recxuzmu4zHkt1KqR.Description: The surface sensible heat flux, also called turbulent heat flux, is the exchange of heat between the surface and the air by motion of air.
recxuzmu4zHkt1KqR.Name: hfss
recxuzmu4zHkt1KqR.Title: Surface Upward Sensible Heat Flux

recy0pGZwaS18z10h.Description: ISCCP Mean Cloud Top Pressure. Time-means are weighted by the ISCCP Total Cloud Fraction {:cltisccp} - see  <http://cfmip.metoffice.com/COSP.html>
recy0pGZwaS18z10h.Name: pctisccp
recy0pGZwaS18z10h.Title: ISCCP Mean Cloud Top Pressure

recy1ntNawtqEdfnM.Description: needed to separate changing vegetation C turnover times resulting from changing allocation versus changing mortality
recy1ntNawtqEdfnM.Name: fVegLitterMortality
recy1ntNawtqEdfnM.Title: Total Carbon Mass Flux from Vegetation to Litter as a Result of Mortality

recy4wcCbfZwUqZw3.Description: Maximum shear stress in sea ice (second stress invariant).
recy4wcCbfZwUqZw3.Name: sistressmax
recy4wcCbfZwUqZw3.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Name - CMIP6: sistremax, CMIP7: sistressmax
recy4wcCbfZwUqZw3.Title: Maximum Shear Stress in Sea Ice

recy5fIGQv9CpOFMT.Description: Droplets are liquid only.  This is the effective radius "as seen from space" over convective liquid cloudy portion of grid cell.  This is the value from uppermost model layer with liquid cloud or, if available, or for some models it is the sum over all liquid cloud tops, no matter where they occur, as long as they are seen from the top of the atmosphere. Reported values are weighted by total liquid cloud top fraction of  (as seen from TOA) each time sample when computing monthly mean.daily data, separated to large-scale clouds, convective clouds. If any of the cloud is from more than one process (i.e. shallow convection), please provide them separately.
recy5fIGQv9CpOFMT.Name: reffcclwtop
recy5fIGQv9CpOFMT.Title: Cloud-Top Effective Droplet Radius in Convective Cloud

recyDyvu53nYExdv7.Description: Upwelling clear-sky longwave radiation at top of atmosphere
recyDyvu53nYExdv7.Name: rlutcs
recyDyvu53nYExdv7.Title: TOA Outgoing Clear-Sky Longwave Radiation

recyIqqUfY5C2z67X.Description: Mole fraction is used in the construction mole\_fraction\_of\_X\_in\_Y, where X is a material constituent of Y.
recyIqqUfY5C2z67X.Name: no2
recyIqqUfY5C2z67X.Title: NO2 Volume Mixing Ratio

recyLA5SfGxnScCqe.Description: Computed as the water flux into the ocean due to land ice (runoff water from surface and base of land ice or melt from base of ice shelf or vertical ice front) into the ocean divided by the area ocean portion of the grid cell
recyLA5SfGxnScCqe.Name: flandice
recyLA5SfGxnScCqe.Title: Water Flux into Sea Water from Land Ice

recyPK5k21t0FjOTy.Description: Sum of particulate calcite component concentrations (e.g. Phytoplankton, Detrital, etc.)
recyPK5k21t0FjOTy.Name: calc
recyPK5k21t0FjOTy.Title: Calcite Concentration

recySmuUeu11muiAs.Description: Net (sum of transport in all directions) snow mass transport through the following four passages, positive into the Arctic Ocean. Note that the definitions of the passages are for SIMIP purposes just meant as default values as given by the physical ocean MIP described in Griffies et al. (2016). Individual models might chose slightly different definitions as given by their grid geometry. 1. Fram Strait: (11.5W,81.3N) to (10.5E,79.6N). 2. Canadian Arctic Archipelago: (128.2W,70.6N) to (59.3W,82.1N). 3. Barents Sea Opening: (16.8E,76.5N) to (19.2E,70.2N). 4. Bering Strait: (171W,66.2N) to (166W,65N).
recySmuUeu11muiAs.Name: sisnmassacrossline
recySmuUeu11muiAs.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Name and Description - CMIP6: snmassacrossline, CMIP7: sisnmassacrossline
recySmuUeu11muiAs.Title: Snow Mass Flux Through Straits

recyWrJVG2CuwKI1r.Description: Mole fraction of isoprene in air.
recyWrJVG2CuwKI1r.Name: isop
recyWrJVG2CuwKI1r.Title: Isoprene Volume Mixing Ratio

recycZ4hDr6izqYff.Description: Percentage of horizontal area occupied by ocean.
recycZ4hDr6izqYff.Name: sftof
recycZ4hDr6izqYff.Title: Sea Area Percentage

recyhaAz839bLm30B.Name: n2oglobal
recyhaAz839bLm30B.Title: Global Mean Mole Fraction of N2O

recyhmfAwJPHVIkfg.Description: Total family (the sum of all appropriate species in the model); list the species in the netCDF header, e.g. NOy = N + NO + NO2 + NO3 + HNO3 + 2N2O5 + HNO4 + ClONO2 + BrONO2 Definition: Total reactive nitrogen; usually includes atomic nitrogen (N), nitric oxide (NO), NO2, nitrogen trioxide (NO3), dinitrogen radical (N2O5), nitric acid (HNO3), peroxynitric acid (HNO4), BrONO2, ClONO2 add comment attribute with detailed description about how the model calculates these fields
recyhmfAwJPHVIkfg.Name: noy
recyhmfAwJPHVIkfg.Title: Total Reactive Nitrogen Volume Mixing Ratio

recyiouTyO92cVL4N.Description: Total NPP of grass in the grid cell
recyiouTyO92cVL4N.Name: nppGrass
recyiouTyO92cVL4N.Title: Net Primary Production on Grass Tiles as Carbon Mass Flux [kgC m-2 s-1]

recyjSItU7jMI0JHK.Description: Total integrated area of all Southern Hemisphere grid cells that are covered by at least 15% areal fraction of sea ice (siconc >= 0.15). Does not include grid cells partially covered by land.
recyjSItU7jMI0JHK.Name: siextents
recyjSItU7jMI0JHK.Title: Sea-Ice Extent South

recykgTbiqhBQS6SZ.Description: Rate of change of snow mass through sublimation divided by grid-cell area. If a model does not differentiate between the sublimation of snow and sea ice, we recommend to report all sublimation within sisndmasssubl as long as the ice is snow covered.
recykgTbiqhBQS6SZ.Name: sisndmasssubl
recykgTbiqhBQS6SZ.Processing Comment: CHANGE SINCE CMIP6 in Name and Description - CMIP6: sndmasssubl, CMIP7: sisndmasssubl
recykgTbiqhBQS6SZ.Title: Snow Mass Rate of Change Through Evaporation or Sublimation

recyvjDmThvPz0Fn8.Description: Vertical/dianeutral diffusivity applied to prognostic salinity field.
recyvjDmThvPz0Fn8.Name: difvso
recyvjDmThvPz0Fn8.Title: Ocean Vertical Salt Diffusivity

recywUtoQFpYZhYBK.Description: The fixation (uptake of nitrogen gas directly from the atmosphere) of nitrogen due to biological processes.
recywUtoQFpYZhYBK.Name: fBNF
recywUtoQFpYZhYBK.Title: Biological Nitrogen Fixation

recyyCi9XlhosvEe3.Description: Mass fraction of atmospheric particulate compounds with an aerodynamic diameter of less than or equal to 2.5 micrometers. To specify the relative humidity and temperature at which the particle size applies, provide scalar coordinate variables with the standard names of "relative\_humidity" and "air\_temperature".
recyyCi9XlhosvEe3.Name: sfpm25
recyyCi9XlhosvEe3.Title: PM2.5 Mass Mixing Ratio in Lowest Model Layer

recz0LmgedQR4lprA.Description: Ocean tracer diffusivity associated with parameterized eddy-induced advective transport. Sometimes this diffusivity is called the 'thickness' diffusivity. For CMIP5, this diagnostic was called 'ocean tracer bolus laplacian diffusivity'.  The CMIP6 name is physically more relevant.
recz0LmgedQR4lprA.Name: diftrblo
recz0LmgedQR4lprA.Title: Ocean Tracer Diffusivity Due to Parameterized Mesoscale Advection

recz0yengIIDVjKs9.Description: In some models part of nitrogen (e.g., root exudate) can go directly into the soil pool without entering litter.
recz0yengIIDVjKs9.Name: fNVegSoil
recz0yengIIDVjKs9.Title: Total Nitrogen Mass Flux from Vegetation Directly to Soil

recz3pEPvo8yVScn1.Description: Heterotrophic respiration is respiration by heterotrophs ("consumers"), which are organisms (including animals and decomposers) that consume other organisms or dead organic material, rather than synthesising organic material from inorganic precursors using energy from the environment (especially sunlight) as autotrophs ("producers") do. Heterotrophic respiration goes on within both the soil and litter pools.
recz3pEPvo8yVScn1.Name: rhc14
recz3pEPvo8yVScn1.Title: Carbon-14 Mass Flux into Atmosphere Due to Heterotrophic Respiration on Land [kgC m-2 s-1]

recz6MY4lcROZIH4K.Description: Fraction of time steps of the averaging period during which sea ice is present (siconc > 0) in a grid cell.
recz6MY4lcROZIH4K.Name: sitimefrac
recz6MY4lcROZIH4K.Title: Fraction of Time Steps with Sea Ice

recz8QebI6EQwYIFj.Description: Required for unambiguous separation of vegetation and soil + litter turnover times, since total fire flux draws from both sources
recz8QebI6EQwYIFj.Name: fVegFire
recz8QebI6EQwYIFj.Title: Carbon Mass Flux from Vegetation into Atmosphere Due to CO2 Emission from All Fire [kgC m-2 s-1]

reczAnftiNoFJWH8r.Name: abs550bc
reczAnftiNoFJWH8r.Title: ambient black carbon aerosol absorption optical depth at 550nm

reczBlHrBzdZJjII4.Description: Mass fraction atmospheric particulate compounds with an aerodynamic diameter of less than or equal to 1 micrometers
reczBlHrBzdZJjII4.Name: mmrpm1
reczBlHrBzdZJjII4.Title: PM1.0 Mass Mixing Ratio

reczDa0dM8QxSX0qJ.Description: Total flux of fresh water from water into sea ice divided by grid-cell area. This flux is positive when fresh water enters the ocean, and is therefore negative during ice growth and positive during ice melt.
reczDa0dM8QxSX0qJ.Name: siflfwbot
reczDa0dM8QxSX0qJ.Title: Freshwater Flux from Sea Ice

reczF6kVGnlb4fLWW.Description: Growth limitation of miscellaneous phytoplankton due to solar irradiance. "Growth limitation due to solar irradiance" means the ratio of the growth rate of a species population in the environment (where the amount of sunlight reaching a location may be limited) to the theoretical growth rate if there were no such limit on solar irradiance.
reczF6kVGnlb4fLWW.Name: limirrmisc
reczF6kVGnlb4fLWW.Title: Irradiance Limitation of Other Phytoplankton

reczFPrC6YMRmjkOt.Name: tauvnogw
reczFPrC6YMRmjkOt.Title: Northward Reynolds stress from non-orographic gravity wave parameterization

reczKOmZ5QuhWRf7g.Name: intppnano
reczKOmZ5QuhWRf7g.Title: Net Primary Mole Productivity of Carbon by nanophytoplankton

reczLrm2HOzqBvLAb.Description: Geopotential height on the 1000 hPa surface
reczLrm2HOzqBvLAb.Name: zg1000
reczLrm2HOzqBvLAb.Title: Geopotential Height at 1000hPa

reczLt1EUG9IW8qmq.Name: gppVgt
reczLt1EUG9IW8qmq.Title: Gross Primary Production on Vegetation type as Carbon Mass Flux

reczN3skJdmEKtZC7.Description: computed as the river flux of water into the ocean divided by the area of the ocean portion of the grid cell.
reczN3skJdmEKtZC7.Name: friver
reczN3skJdmEKtZC7.Title: Water Flux into Sea Water from Rivers

reczOfSASlNuuavTE.Description: Inflow of River Water into Cell
reczOfSASlNuuavTE.Name: rivi
reczOfSASlNuuavTE.Title: River Inflow

reczSHX6KEZm9s2DV.Description: The relative humidity with respect to liquid water for T> 0 C, and with respect to ice for T<0 C.
reczSHX6KEZm9s2DV.Name: hur
reczSHX6KEZm9s2DV.Title: Relative Humidity

reczYxXDaWxmIqjcz.Description: The mass of air in an atmospheric layer.
reczYxXDaWxmIqjcz.Name: airmass
reczYxXDaWxmIqjcz.Title: Vertically Integrated Mass Content of Air in Layer

reczbRSXC8jrDniqo.Description: Flux corresponding to rlut resulting from aerosol-free call to radiation, following Ghan (ACP, 2013)
reczbRSXC8jrDniqo.Name: rlutaf
reczbRSXC8jrDniqo.Title: TOA Outgoing Aerosol-Free Longwave Radiation

reczdi9T7IL4Z3tv8.Description: total primary (organic carbon) production by phytoplankton
reczdi9T7IL4Z3tv8.Name: ppos
reczdi9T7IL4Z3tv8.Title: Primary Carbon Production by Phytoplankton

recze8fHteIUNd627.Description: Fixed surface layer mixing ratio over 30o-50oN (0 ppbv), uniform fixed source (at all levels) everywhere else (source is unspecified but must be constant in space and time and documented). Note that the source could be 1yr/yr, so the tracer concentration provides mean age in years. For method using linearly increasing tracer include a method attribute: "linearly increasing tracer"For method using uniform source (1yr/yr) include a method attribute: "uniform source"
recze8fHteIUNd627.Name: aoanh
recze8fHteIUNd627.Title: Northern Hemisphere Tracer Lifetime

reczxY34ootLwt5pU.Description: Total RA of grass in the grid cell
reczxY34ootLwt5pU.Name: raGrass
reczxY34ootLwt5pU.Title: Autotrophic Respiration on Grass Tiles as Carbon Mass Flux [kgC m-2 s-1]

fldAeipOcVEEnp02z.description: Numerical value for each priority level.
fldAeipOcVEEnp02z.name: Value

fldLknlkF0aMDl602.description: Variables groups assigned to each priority level.
fldLknlkF0aMDl602.name: Variable Group

rec4owvb8u9iAzZhl.Name: Core
rec4owvb8u9iAzZhl.Notes: Top priority, reserved for variables selected for inclusion in the Baseline Climate Variables. These variables should be produced for all experiments.

rec5ywZG7SCru2OY4.Name: High
rec5ywZG7SCru2OY4.Notes: The variables support the core objectives of the opportunity.  These are required to make the opportunity viable.

recvhUkiMNduBXDV4.Name: Medium
recvhUkiMNduBXDV4.Notes: These variables deliver extra information that can then enable people to go further and push the scientific boundaries further.

recylidc6nYvEllAd.Name: Low
recylidc6nYvEllAd.Notes: These variables help to fill gaps and are more speculative. This is information that will be useful if it is available, bearing in mind modelling centres may have data on tape that they could output. This priority level can also be used for data that has prior agreement to be produced by particular modelling centres, so it is not expected by additional centres unless they wish to participate.

rec01COyc86RxZJZo.Field 12: Includes transport of both sea ice and snow by advection
rec01COyc86RxZJZo.Field 13: Temporal mean, Global field (single level) [XY-na] {on model mesh points} [tmean]

rec064HE6IXsrR5bC.Field 11: Ocean Y Overturning Mass Streamfunction Due to Parameterized Submesoscale Advection
rec064HE6IXsrR5bC.Field 12: Report only if there is a submesoscale eddy parameterization. [Function of Y, Z, basin. For a model with a cartesian latxlon grid, this is the same as the "Ocean Meridional Overturning Mass Streamfunction" (msftmzsmpa) and should in this case be omitted. ]
rec064HE6IXsrR5bC.Field 13: Temporal mean, Ocean Basin Meridional Section [YB-O] [bzzsum]
rec064HE6IXsrR5bC.Title (from Variables (Import)): Ocean Y Overturning Mass Streamfunction Due to Parameterized Submesoscale Advection

rec0CHzcNjPXeQcnb.Field 12: Near-surface (usually, 2 meter) specific humidity. [Normally, the specific humidity should be reported at the 2 meter height]

rec0CR8eUMEGXqQEB.Field 13: Temporal mean, Global field (sum over depth) [XY-na] [amdss-tmn]

rec0HTL8CHb01BUey.Field 11: Mass Fraction of Stratiform Cloud Liquid Water
rec0HTL8CHb01BUey.Field 12: Calculated as the mass of stratiform cloud liquid water in the grid cell divided by the mass of air (including the water in all phases) in the grid cell.  This includes precipitating hydrometeors ONLY if the precipitating hydrometeors affect the calculation of radiative transfer in model.
rec0HTL8CHb01BUey.Field 13: Temporal mean, Global field on model atmosphere levels [XY-A]
rec0HTL8CHb01BUey.Title (from Variables (Import)): Mass Fraction of Stratiform Cloud Liquid Water

rec0RJ6DbDw1F09lg.Field 11: Aerosol Level Absorption Optical Thickness for Each Band
rec0RJ6DbDw1F09lg.Field 12: Optical thickness of atmospheric aerosols in wavelength bands.
rec0RJ6DbDw1F09lg.Field 13: Instantaneous value (i.e. synoptic or time-step value), Global field on model atmosphere levels [XY-A] {spectband:} [tpt]
rec0RJ6DbDw1F09lg.Title (from Variables (Import)): Aerosol Level Absorption Optical Thickness for Each Band

rec0S6NPkB5z5MyeP.Field 12: Geopotential is the sum of the specific gravitational potential energy relative to the geoid and the specific centripetal potential energy. Geopotential height is the geopotential divided by the standard acceleration due to gravity. It is numerically similar to the altitude (or geometric height) and not to the quantity with standard name height, which is relative to the surface.
rec0S6NPkB5z5MyeP.Field 13: Instantaneous value (i.e. synoptic or time-step value), Atmospheric profiles at specified sites [S-A] [tpt]

rec0TsDpIYqLMCK20.Field 11: Moisture in Upper Portion of Soil Column of Land-Use Tile
rec0TsDpIYqLMCK20.Field 12: the mass of water in all phases in a thin surface layer; integrate over uppermost 10cm
rec0TsDpIYqLMCK20.Title (from Variables (Import)): Moisture in Upper Portion of Soil Column of Land-Use Tile

rec0WFjz0lcNaldEs.Field 11: Carbon Mass in Vegetation on Shrub Tiles
rec0WFjz0lcNaldEs.Field 12: 'Content' indicates a quantity per unit area. 'Vegetation' means any plants e.g. trees, shrubs, grass. Plants are autotrophs i.e. 'producers' of biomass using carbon obtained from carbon dioxide.
rec0WFjz0lcNaldEs.Title (from Variables (Import)): Carbon Mass in Vegetation on Shrub Tiles

rec0ZhGjHpngoabdZ.Field 12: This is the mean of the speed, not the speed computed from the mean u and v components of wind [normally, the the wind  should be reported at the 10 meter height]

The partial pressure of a gaseous constituent of air is the pressure which it alone would exert with unchanged temperature and number of moles per unit volume. Net primary production is the excess of gross primary production (rate of synthesis of biomass from inorganic precursors) by autotrophs ('producers'), for example, photosynthesis in plants or phytoplankton, over the rate at which the autotrophs themselves respire some of this biomass. 'Productivity' means production per unit area. The phrase 'expressed_as' is used in the construction A_expressed_as_B, where B is a chemical constituent of A. It means that the quantity indicated by the standard name is calculated solely with respect to the B contained in A, neglecting all other chemical constituents of A. [needed for any model that does not compute GPP]

rec6dcelLF5oNVATQ.Justification:
This opportunity is focused on the impacts of climate variability and change on urban  population and the built environment. With more than half the global population living in cities, and this number being projected to rapidly increase, this request is essential to support impacts assessments, adaptation strategies, and sustainable and resilient urban development amidst the challenges posed by a changing climate.

The requested variables can support studies focused on understanding projected impacts to urban environments (both people and infrastructure). One manifestation of such impacts is the urban heat island, which requires detailed sub-daily variables to be modelled. Another strong impact of weather extremes on cities is given by surface flooding, which depends strongly on precipitation rates. Finally, some requested variable support studies into the urban PBL height, which modulates the impacts of air pollution.

The additional temporal resolution will enable analyses of onset and development of events.

A vast amount of literature supports the need for this data requirement and describes case studies. Some examples are listed below:

https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/sustainable-cities/articles/10.3389/frsc.2021.645613/full
https://royalsocietypublishing.org/doi/full/10.1098/rstb.2019.0124
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1352231021003745
https://iopscience.iop.org/article/10.1088/1748-9326/acf94c/pdf
https://www.mdpi.com/2225-1154/3/2/391
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0378778822008477
https://www.mdpi.com/2073-4441/16/3/474
rec6dcelLF5oNVATQ.Name: urban_impacts_additional
rec6dcelLF5oNVATQ.Title: Additional variables to study impacts of climate variability and change on cities

(1) Fire variables (burned area fraction and fire carbon emissions) will be utilized to:
a) Analyze historical changes in fire patterns and project future scenarios under various climate and socio-economic conditions, informing long-term environmental planning and policy-making.
b) Assess and improve fire simulations in coupled Earth System Models, leading to more accurate climate predictions and a deeper understanding of Earth's complex systems.

(2) A comprehensive set of variables including carbon, nitrogen, water, and energy cycles; vegetation distribution and structure; surface climate (e.g., temperature, precipitation, wind speed); atmospheric circulation, composition, and chemistry;  sea surface temperature, sea water salinity and sea ice coverage will be analyzed to:
a) Investigate the drivers behind changing fire regimes.
b) Understand the underlying cross-sphere feedbacks between fire and various Earth system components.
recCkVgGbLv7eQhvS.Name: FireMIP_monthly
recCkVgGbLv7eQhvS.Title: FireMIP variables at monthly timeslices

recDNbRl59BAZsMJM.Justification:
The proposed set of monthly variables are considered high priority for DAMIP to assess changes in the climate system and the role of forcings in driving those changes.

- daily temperature, precipitation, humidity and surface wind variables for assessing compound extremes, their changes, and the role of forcings in those changes (tas, tasmax, tasmin, pr, prsn, hurs, huss, day.sfcWind, day.sfcWindmax.

- surface fluxes and hydrological variables for assessing the processes involved in temperature extremes (mrros, rsds, rlds, prw)

- circulation related variables for assessing the circulation associated with extremes and more generally how features like the storm tracks are changing under different forcings.  psl, ps, zg, ua, va, wap, ta
